title: Cost router — record, report, per-decision cost endpoints
acceptance_criteria: CostEventRequest Pydantic model with decision_id, event_type, amount, currency fields
POST /api/memory/{project}/cost/record — records cost event, returns confirmation
GET /api/memory/{project}/cost/report — returns full CostReport for project
Router named cost_router, follows impact_router pattern
All errors logged, no bare except
